2.1 Raw Material - The material shall be made either from fresh coconut kernels or from dried coconut copra of good quality free from moulds.
1.1 The expelling l screw-pi essmg J operation shall be conducted in the usual way perhaps in two passes but under mild conditions designed to achieve the maximum protem quality at the specified oil content. 2.3 The flour, obtained by gnndmg the cake, shall be of light brown colour, uniform in composition and free flam Insect, rodent or fungal infestation, objectionable odour and rancrd taste. It shall not contain added flavouring or colouring agents or any other exn aneous matter. It shall be free from harmful foreign oilcakcs, such as castor and MAHUA when tested in accordance with the method prC~CI ibed in 11 and 12 of IS: 7874 (Part I) - 1975*, i espectrvely. It shall also be Irec from NEEM cake and other foreign materials such as jaggery and molasses
2.4 Particle Size - Unless other wise specified by the purchaser, the material shall be such that It passes compJf"tely through a 250-rn1CTQn IS Sieve ( see IS : 460 - 1962t ).
